caption_L1: Here a is a line diagram titled Ukraine : Youth unemployment rate from 1999 to 2020. Youth unemployment rate is drawn along the y-axis. A linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 can be seen on the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: The Youth unemployment rate reaches it's lowest point of ~0.13 in 2007/2008. The largest surge is from ~0.175 - 2.3 from 2013 - 2014. After consistently dropping from 2000 - 2007/2008, it increasingly ramps up, plateaus, then ramps up again.
